description: Japanese input method based on Mozkey and Mozc, with live conversion and Grimodex integration
notes: Unsigned experimental build intended for Grimodex integration. Review the upstream project's warnings before use.
Requires Windows 10 1809 or later and administrator approval. Installs the official MSI system-wide, including IME registration, a service, and firewall rules.
Select Mozkey IbG from the Windows input method selector after installation. A sign-out or restart may be required.
Use Scoop for updates and removal. Restart Windows after uninstalling. No restart is initiated automatically.

script: if ($process.ExitCode -notin @(0, 3010)) { throw ('MSI installation failed with exit code ' + $process.ExitCode + '. See ' + $logPath) }
if ($process.ExitCode -eq 3010) { warn 'Restart Windows to complete the installation. No restart was initiated.' }
if ($process.ExitCode -eq 1605) { warn 'The MSI product is not installed. No system product was removed.'; return }
if ($process.ExitCode -notin @(0, 3010)) { throw ('MSI uninstallation failed with exit code ' + $process.ExitCode + '. See ' + $logPath) }
warn 'Restart Windows to complete IME removal. No restart was initiated.'
